records.title: International Valuation Standards
verifiedFacts: IVSC states the latest edition was published on 31 January 2024.
IVSC states the edition is effective from 31 January 2025 for valuations performed on or after that date.
IVSC permits early adoption from publication.
IVS compliance requires applicable General Standards, appendices and Asset Standards.

records.title: International Valuation Standards - Arabic official library source
verifiedFacts: TAQEEM official digital library provides the current International Valuation Standards Arabic source.
The official TAQEEM-hosted document states an effective date of 31 January 2025.

records.title: RICS Valuation - Global Standards (Red Book)
verifiedFacts: RICS identifies the 2025 edition as the current Red Book Global Standards.
RICS states the edition is effective from 31 January 2025.
RICS states national legal requirements take precedence where requirements conflict.
RICS states the 2025 edition aligns with IVS effective from 31 January 2025.

records.title: RICS Global Valuation Standards 2025 - Arabic library source
verifiedFacts: TAQEEM official digital library lists the RICS Global Valuation Standards 2025 Arabic source.

records.title: ESG and sustainability in commercial property valuation, 4th edition
verifiedFacts: RICS states the 4th edition was published on 28 January 2026.
RICS states the 4th edition is effective from 30 April 2026.
The standard distinguishes valuation from strategic ESG risk advice.

records.title: Comparable evidence in real estate valuation, 1st edition
verifiedFacts: RICS states members and regulated firms should continue to adopt the 1st edition until the final 2nd edition is published.
RICS states the document was reissued in April 2023 as a professional standard with regulatory requirements unchanged.

records.title: Comparable evidence in real estate valuation, 2nd edition - consultation draft
verifiedFacts: RICS consultation opened on 8 July 2026.
RICS consultation closes on 18 September 2026.
The 2nd edition is a consultation draft and is not the current final edition as of 8 September 2026.

records.title: Accredited Valuers Law and TAQEEM rules portal
verifiedFacts: TAQEEM official rules portal lists the Accredited Valuers Law.
The official law document identifies Royal Decree M/43 dated 7/9/1433H and amendments.

records.title: Regulations of Real Estate Consultation & Analysis Services
verifiedFacts: REGA official source marks the regulation Active.
Article 4 requires an accredited valuer license when services involve real estate valuation.
The regulation requires consultation information to be accurate and not misleading or inconsistent with official or licensed data.
